language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change this anytime in Settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to NGUMU
welcome.subtitle: Focus better, protect your eyes, and take control of your screen time. Your first 40 days are on us — full Pro access, no card needed.

mode.title: Choose your focus style
mode.subtitle: Pick a default mode. You can switch any time from the Focus screen.

eyeHealth.title: Protect your eyes
eyeHealth.subtitle: The 20-20-20 rule and blink warnings keep your eyes healthy during long sessions.

blocking.title: Block distractions
blocking.subtitle: NGUMU can shield distracting apps and websites during your focus sessions.
blocking.androidUsage: Usage Access — track which apps are in the foreground
blocking.androidOverlay: Display Over Apps — show the NGUMU block screen over distractions
blocking.androidNotifications: Notifications — get reminded when focus ends
blocking.iosScreenTime: Screen Time APIs — Apple-approved app shielding via FamilyControls
blocking.iosLimitation: Some system-level blocking may be limited by iOS restrictions
blocking.nextHint: We'll ask for these permissions on the next screen.

permissions.title: Setup Permissions
permissions.subtitle: NGUMU needs a few system permissions to effectively monitor your screen time and block distracting apps.
permissions.usageAccessDesc: Allows NGUMU to track which apps you are currently using.
permissions.overlayDesc: Needed to show the block screen over distracting applications.
permissions.notificationsDesc: Get alerts when your focus session starts and ends.
permissions.screenTimeDesc: NGUMU uses Apple's Screen Time APIs to shield distracting apps during focus sessions.
permissions.iosNote: iOS uses Apple-approved Screen Time APIs (FamilyControls). System-level app blocking requires iOS 16+ and your permission. Some features may be limited by iOS restrictions.

prePrompt.title: Stay in the loop
prePrompt.body: NGUMU uses notifications to tell you when focus starts, breaks begin, and your trial is ending. You can change this later in Settings.

trial.title: 40 days of Pro, free
trial.subtitle: You get full Pro access for 40 days — app blocking, website blocking, custom modes, strict breaks, analytics, and more. After your trial, the basic timer stays free.
trial.inviteSubtitle: Claim a code to extend your free trial. Try {{demo}} for +{{days}} days.

start.title: You're all set!
start.subtitle: Everything is configured. Start your first focus session now, or jump right into the app.

paywall.title: NGUMU Pro
paywall.trialLeft: You have {{count}} trial days of full Pro access left
paywall.active: Pro is active on this device
paywall.trialExpired: Your 40-day trial has ended — the basic timer stays free forever
paywall.hardPaywall: Trial expired — unlock Pro to continue
paywall.error: Could not load plans. Check your connection and pull down to retry, or tap Restore if you already purchased.
paywall.noPlans: No plans available right now. Tap Restore if you already purchased, or try again later.
paywall.priceNote: Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage in your device's store settings.
paywall.restoredBody: Your NGUMU Pro license is active on this device.
paywall.noPurchasesBody: No active NGUMU Pro purchases were found for this account.
paywall.restoreFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
paywall.notConfigured: Payments are not fully configured yet. Restore may still work if you have a previous purchase.
paywall.almostThereBody: Payment received but entitlement is still syncing. Try Restore in a moment.
paywall.purchaseUnavailableBody: Check your connection and try again. If the problem persists, contact support.
paywall.trialExpiredBody: Your 40-day trial has ended. The basic timer remains free, but Pro features require a subscription.

dashboard.shieldSetup: Set up your app & website blocklist

blocking.title: Blocking
blocking.appsHint: During focus sessions, NGUMU will try to block these apps. Android enforcement is strongest; iOS uses Screen Time APIs where available.
blocking.sitesHint: Add domains to block during focus sessions. Use blacklist or allowlist mode.
blocking.emptyHint: Tap above to add your first distraction.

stats.title: Insights
stats.proRequired: CSV export is a Pro feature.

break.title: Break time
break.subtitle: Look 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Rest your eyes.
break.strict: Strict break mode is on — take this break to continue.

errors.offline: You're offline. Some features may be unavailable until you reconnect.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
